summary: Enforce one membership per canonical issue per Reading Plan (#3037): prove no duplicate (plan_id, issue_id) pairs exist before the unique constraint is added.

preflight_checks.name: no duplicate canonical issue memberships in reading plans
preflight_checks.condition: reading_plan_issues contains no (plan_id, issue_id) pair more than once
preflight_checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT plan_id, issue_id FROM reading_plan_issues GROUP BY plan_id, issue_id HAVING count(*) > 1) AS duplicates
